units.source_text: 源氏公子回到二条院私邸，但见自己殿内的众侍女似乎昨晚没有睡觉，

en.t: Prince Genji returned to his private residence at Nijo-in, only to find that the many ladies in his own apartments seemed not to have slept the night before,

units.source_text: 群集在各处，都在悲叹时势的乖变。

en.t: and were gathered here and there, all lamenting the cruel change in his fortunes.

units.source_text: 侍从室里人影全无，这都是平素亲近的人，

en.t: There was not a soul to be seen in the attendants' room; these were the people normally closest to him,

units.source_text: 他们为欲随从公子赴须磨，都回去与亲友道别了。

en.t: and because they meant to follow the prince to Suma, they had all gone home to say farewell to relatives and friends.

units.source_text: 与公子交情不深的人，惟恐来访问了将受右大臣谴责，因而增多烦恼。

en.t: Those who were not deeply connected with the prince feared that visiting him would bring censure from the Minister of the Right, and so their anxieties only increased.

units.source_text: 所以本来门前车马云集，几无隙地；

en.t: Thus the gate, once crowded with carriages and horses until there was hardly any space left,

units.source_text: 如今冷冷清清，无人上门了。

en.t: was now desolate and silent, with no one coming to call.

units.source_text: 此时源氏公子方悟世态之炎凉与人情之浇薄，感慨系之。

en.t: Only then did Prince Genji understand the fickleness of the world and the shallowness of human feeling, and he was deeply moved by it.

units.source_text: 餐厅里的饭桌半是尘埃堆积，铺地的软席处处折叠起来了。

en.t: The dining tables were half covered with dust, and the soft floor mats had been folded up here and there.

units.source_text: 源氏公子想：“我在家时尚且如此，将来我走了，更不知何等荒凉呢！”

en.t: Prince Genji thought, "If it is already like this while I am still at home, how desolate will it become after I am gone?"
